title: Crash Nitro Kart
statusNote: Main menu, then Single Player > Arcade > Single Race > Medium > Crash > first track: the race runs with karts, items, minimap and the pause menu. The lettering in every menu is drawn scrambled (still just readable); the race itself looks right.
notes: Menus are chosen with the left soft key or 5, not with OK; the right soft key goes back.
The menu lettering is scrambled in this build. Main menu from the top: Single Player, Multiplayer, N-Gage Arena, Options, High Scores, Quit. Single Player offers Adventure, Arcade and Time Trial.
Multiplayer (Bluetooth) and N-Gage Arena cannot work here.
The main menu starts a demo race when left idle for about 25 seconds; a soft key returns to the menu.

multiplayer.menu: Main menu > Multiplayer (second from the top, below Single Player)

controls.source: The game's defaults from its Options > Controls screen (Hop 2, Brake 8, Fire 4, Accel 5; the game can change them there), read from scrambled lettering. Accelerate, hop, the soft keys and the pause menu were confirmed in a race; steering, brake and fire were not checked there.
notes: Racing layout: steer on the arrows, A accelerates, Z brakes, S hops, Space fires. Enter is the left soft key because that is what selects in this game's menus; Escape goes back.
On a gamepad A or the right trigger accelerates (and selects in menus), X or the left trigger brakes, the shoulder buttons hop, B or Y fires, Start pauses and Select goes back.
